fix.pr_body:
## What was missing The site uses the [Keyrune](https://keyrune.andrewgioia.com/) icon font for Magic set symbols (loaded in both decksite and logsite headers) but had no attribution to the library's author anywhere visible to users. ## What changed - `decksite/templates/footer.mustache`: Added `

Set icons courtesy of keyrune.andrewgioia.com.

` inside the existing attribution `
` alongside the deckbox.org credit. - `logsite/templates/footer.mustache`: Added the same attribution line inside the `
` element. Two 1-line template edits, no logic changes. ## Validation - `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed - Unit tests not run (no database available in this environment); the change is pure HTML template text with no code paths to exercise. Fixes #11252
fix.pr_title: Add keyrune set icon attribution to footers (#11252)
